name: RSE-Fixes
description: Part of RSE (RuneScape Enhanced). Fixes falling through player-built pieces after joining or teleporting (server or host, off by default), and logs what your game or the server knows about the buildings around each player.

settings.label: Debug
settings.tooltip: Automatic reports and log lines in ue4ss\UE4SS.log. Off: the mod does nothing until you use the button below or the console commands.

settings.label: Fix: falling through buildings (server or host)
Hold arriving players
settings.tooltip: When a player from another machine joins or teleports onto a building, the server holds them until the building has collision there, places them on top and lets them go. Arriving on the ground: no hold. Only works where the server runs: the host's game, or a dedicated server with this mod.

settings.label: Longest hold
settings.tooltip: After this long without building collision under them, the player is let go where they are.

settings.label: Automatic reports
settings.tooltip: With Debug on: after a teleport, join or respawn (on a host also for every arriving player), and when your footing turns unstable, write a short report on nearby buildings to UE4SS.log.

settings.label: Teleport distance (m)
settings.tooltip: Distance moved within a quarter of a second that counts as a teleport.

settings.label: Log building diagnostics now
settings.tooltip: Writes a full report now and short ones after 2, 5 and 10 seconds. Same as the console command fixes_buildings.
